text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Seeking the Pearl burst
energetically into the trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come now, pack your bags!
We're challenging the world's races!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes! Tough horsegirls are waiting for us across the ocean!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First stop, France!
Bonjour, Calvados!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An overseas expedition had always been Seeking the Pearl's dream.
While certainly not impossible given her talent—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Applying to Tracen Academy, getting URA approval, registering abroad,
securing accommodations... The paperwork alone would take considerable time.
choice_data_list: It'll be tough to race right away.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I've already accounted for that♪ While we wait,
we can use that time to acclimatize to the French turf and air.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thorough training in the local environment—
everything is completely all right, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to have given serious thought to making the most of her time abroad.
However, domestic procedures still take time. In that case, let's use that—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —The VR Umalator! We're using this, aren't we!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The VR Umalator is a race simulator.
It can replicate various racecourses, weather conditions, and more.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
With this, we can recreate racecourses and formidable horsegirls from all over the world!
Very good!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come, let's boot up the simulator!
I shall demonstrate my potential even in virtual space!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inputting the data, I initiated the program.
Recreated was a French race, featuring powerhouse horsegirls from around the globe!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Springy turf... Fufu, it suits my stride perfectly!
I'll accelerate straight to top speed!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This long straightaway is the road leading straight to glory!
Horsegirls of the world! Can you keep up with me!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving her fierce rivals in the dust, Seeking the Pearl
blazed across the finish line in first place...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No!! It cannot be called flawless yet!
Next, please spawn bison and deer on the track!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
History shows wild animals intruding on international races!
That could easily happen in my races too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Unpredictable developments, unforeseen troubles!
Only when you've overcome all of them can you truly say you are 'prepared'!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I shall run through every 'future' imaginable!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The world stage Seeking the Pearl aimed for was uncharted territory.
No amount of preparation would ever truly be enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll let her experience every conceivable scenario.
As her trainer, I'll grant everything she desires!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Temperature around 40°C! Bone-dry turf!
And of course, we need the exact opposite pattern as well!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Could you also randomize
each horsegirl's condition!?
choice_data_list: Just give me time to input the data!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Gooood!! I leave that to you!
Now then, next we run under an American scenario!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Determined to match Seeking the Pearl's enthusiasm,
I sat glued to the computer... until morning broke.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Seeking the Pearl is waiting in the gym.
...Must... get to... the gym...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Is Trainer running late?
...Oh my, the data input is completely finished!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, impressive work for a single night.
Come, let's run to our heart's content!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that all-nighter, Seeking the Pearl was able
to challenge endless possibilities within the virtual realm.
